blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books; word forms checked with the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я ем только мясо животных, ___ сам убил и разделал.
exercises.why: **которых** — it refers to **животных** (plural), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: I only eat meat from animals that I have personally killed and butchered.

exercises.why: **которая** — it refers to **страна** (feminine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: Haiti is a nation that seems hopelessly impoverished.

exercises.q: Я принципиально не смотрю фильмы, в ___ есть клише.
exercises.why: **которых** — it refers to **фильмы** (plural), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: As a rule, I don't watch movies with clichés.

exercises.q: Я предоставил им всю информацию, ___ они запросили.
exercises.why: **которую** — it refers to **информацию** (feminine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: I gave them all the information they requested.

exercises.why: **которая** — it refers to **Ирландка** (feminine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: The Irish girl, who is writing in Irish, is a writer.

exercises.q: И где здесь ошибка, о ___ ты мне так долго талдычил?
exercises.why: **которой** — it refers to **ошибка** (feminine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: So where's the mistake you've been harping on for so long?

exercises.q: Я знаю очень хороший шампунь, ___ убирает себорею.
exercises.why: **который** — it refers to **шампунь** (masculine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: I know a very good shampoo that takes seborrhea away.

exercises.q: Все иранцы, ___ я встречал, были прекрасными людьми.
exercises.why: **которых** — it refers to **иранцы** (plural), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: Every Iranian I've met has been a great person.

exercises.q: Том подмёл пол новым веником, ___ ему дала Мэри.
exercises.why: **который** — it refers to **веником** (masculine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: Tom swept the floor with the new broom Mary had given him.

exercises.q: Том спит на диване, ___ раскладывается в кровать.
exercises.why: **который** — it refers to **диване** (masculine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: Tom sleeps on a sofa that converts into a bed.

exercises.q: Калькулятор, ___ я купил, не поддерживает мнимые числа.
exercises.why: **который** — it refers to **Калькулятор** (masculine singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: The calculator I bought does not support imaginary numbers.

exercises.q: Поле, на ___ мы раньше играли в мяч, сейчас застроено.
exercises.why: **котором** — it refers to **Поле** (neuter singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: The field where we used to play ball is now all built up.

exercises.q: Она обзывала его всеми ругательными словами, ___ знала.
exercises.why: **которые** — it refers to **словами** (plural), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: She called him every bad name she knew.

exercises.q: Ты знаешь какое-нибудь блюдо, в ___ есть лавровый лист?
exercises.why: **котором** — it refers to **блюдо** (neuter singular), and its case is that of its own clause. «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 53.
exercises.prompt: Do you know of a dish that has laurel leaves in it?
